diagnosis.reason: Input point fell inside an iframe before its compositor hit region was registered; the existing wheel test already targets the top-level strip. Pinch now uses that same top-level strip. Explicit iframe input assertions remain.

diagnosis.test: reading tools, new empty Markdown tab
diagnosis.reason: Never-presented warmup view can return an empty hidden capture. Only previously presented readers need old scroll-frame flushing; first presentation uses prepared layout. Added unit coverage and reran the full suite.

root_cause.cause: Own atomic save emitted document:external-change before renderer accepted saved disk version. Transient notice resized/moved native reader even though DOM scrollY was stable.
root_cause.pixel_tracking_note: Tracking source is original screen recording; the saved video crops the test window area. Heading was at y=438 after reader presentation and remained there through auto-save.

early_dom_checks_limitation: Earlier 30-frame DOM-only checks did not establish a fix: the user still saw a jump. A real desktop recording and every native bounds write exposed the transient notice. Final regression tests include auto-save, native bounds and notifications as well as 180 Chromium frames.

desktop_immediate_case.note: No native bounds changes or external notices; final heading position remains stable after presentation.

browser_zoom_followup.before_fix: Full run native frame input sometimes preceded current compositor hit regions despite updated getZoomFactor. Standalone baseline comparison passed, so baseline failure was not assumed.
browser_zoom_followup.change: Use a top-level point for initial pinch; before the single explicit iframe wheel input, capture the current visible native frame and require a nonempty result. All factor/content/frame/focus assertions remain.
browser_zoom_followup.after_fix: 1 targeted Electron scenario passed in 5.6 seconds, retries=0

initial_performance_comparison.resolution: Only changed revisions need a hidden compositor capture. The already presented unchanged revision uses its prepared layout without another readback. Full contract and new independent comparative run required.
